newsitem.title: USA: Ultra Pac sees Q2 margins more favorable.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Pac sees Q2 margins more favorable.

text.p: Ultra Pac Inc said it expects its gross profit margin for the second quarter ending July 31 to be more favorable than anticipated.
It said this is mainly a result of its ability to purchase PETE resin and recycled material, the primary component of its product cost, at prices favorable to market.
The company also said that it now expects its earnings in the second quarter "to significantly exceed those of the first quarter of this year and last year's second quarter."
Ultra Pac is in the food packaging business.
